speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you've been experiencing this swelling in your right knee?

speaker: Patient
text: 18-month-old boy. The patient is brought in by his parents due to swelling in his right knee noticed after playing in the park. The parents report that there was no obvious injury or incident at the park that could have led to the swelling. Upon further questioning, the mother recalls that an uncle on her side of the family had similar problems, suggesting a possible genetic component.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease. The age (18 months), insidious onset of right knee swelling without trauma, and strong family history are highly suggestive of this idiopathic avascular necrosis of the femoral head. REQUEST IMAGES: X-ray_pelvis_femur.
